### 2. Scope of services

You are the electrical services engineer. Your job is to give the building safe, reliable power, lighting and communications that suit how it is used, fit the supply available, and can be built and maintained.
To do this you:
- Confirm the supply early: the load, the capacity available and what the network operator needs. Never assume spare capacity.
- Design the selected systems to the level of detail each appointed stage buys.
- Keep the measured, utility and calculated basis of the design, and registers of utility matters, deliverables and decisions.
For the office or retail space, this includes tenancy metering and capacity set aside for tenants' fit-outs.
Power to process equipment is not process design. The network operator, its accredited service provider (Level 3), the ICT operator and the contractors keep their own duties. Your reviews and witnessing are not installation testing or certification.

### 3. Allowances

Editable client defaults: 4 design meetings per appointed design stage, 1 consolidated review round per design stage and 1 investigation visit when commissioned. These are pricing assumptions, not measured project quantities. Price later stages separately. In R1/R2, identify the affected buildings and systems from the supplied project information; list assets, tests, durations, authority fees and specialist services separately, with assumptions and excess rates. Do not apply a single count to different units. Agree unresolved scope before the affected work starts.

| Item | Allowance | Qty |
|---|---|---|
| Design meetings | Per appointed design stage (editable client default) | 4 |
| Design review rounds | Consolidated client review round per design stage (editable client default) | 1 |
| Construction inspections | Hold-point visits; firm states duration, review support and excess rates separately | 4 |

### 5. Terms

- Engage under Project electrical agreement (attached), scope/fees/addenda and written acceptance; settle conflicts/precedence. RFP authorises no work.
- Written authority before scope/quantity/ceiling/rate/program changes; reason/approval/cost/time stated.
- Approved brief/revisions set baseline; ordinary coordination/design development included.
- Own-error correction included; reasonable professional skill/care within competence.
- Pay 30 days from correct milestone invoices; R6 declares prepayment/release, interest/recovery/suspension.
- State rate hold/escalation; preapprove extras/expenses; no duplicate fees.
- Valid 90 days after closing; R1 separates tax/base/options.
- Send questions in writing to Project manager by 2026-10-23.
- Issue numbered addenda to all, acknowledged in R1.
- Agree project copying/use/alteration/native-file/reliance/retention/handover rights; authorised/lawful disclosure allowed, marketing by consent.
- Settle caps/indemnities, law/disputes, notices/cure/termination, assignment/novation/subcontracts; insurance is not a cap.
